questions.prompt: ★ What happens when 1PB is pressed momentarily in this off-delay circuit?
options: Only SOL-A and SOL-B energize; 1TRA stays open
SOL-A and SOL-B energize only while the button is held
SOL-A and 1TR energize and stay energized; 1TRA closes and energizes SOL-B
questions.answer: SOL-A and 1TR energize and stay energized; 1TRA closes and energizes SOL-B
questions.explanation: 1CR seals in through 1CRA. 1CRB then supplies SOL-A and 1TR. An off-delay NO contact closes immediately on energization, so 1TRA powers SOL-B.

reviewCue.text: Review Sensor 3-5.pdf, PDF page 6. 1CR seals in through 1CRA. 1CRB then supplies SOL-A and 1TR. An off-delay NO contact closes immediately on energization, so 1TRA powers SOL-B.

questions.prompt: ★ With 1CR energized, what happens when 2PB is pressed momentarily?
options: Everything de-energizes and shuts off immediately
SOL-B waits the time set on 1TR and then energizes
Everything de-energizes except SOL-B, which stays on until the off-delay expires and 1TRA opens
Everything shuts off, then re-energizes when 2PB is released
questions.answer: Everything de-energizes except SOL-B, which stays on until the off-delay expires and 1TRA opens
questions.explanation: 2PB breaks the seal-in circuit. SOL-A and the timer coil lose power, but the off-delay 1TRA contact stays closed for its preset interval before switching SOL-B off.

reviewCue.text: Review Sensor 3-5.pdf, PDF page 8. 2PB breaks the seal-in circuit. SOL-A and the timer coil lose power, but the off-delay 1TRA contact stays closed for its preset interval before switching SOL-B off.

questions.prompt: ★ What is the term for the group 1PB, 1CR and 1CRA on the first two rungs?
questions.explanation: 1CRA is wired around 1PB. Once 1CR energizes, that contact holds the circuit on after the momentary Start button is released.

reviewCue.text: Review Sensor 3-5.pdf, PDF page 10. 1CRA is wired around 1PB. Once 1CR energizes, that contact holds the circuit on after the momentary Start button is released.

questions.prompt: ★ What happens when 1PB is held pressed and the timer has finished timing?
options: Both red and green lights are on
Both red and green lights are off
Green light is off; red light is on
questions.answer: Green light is off; red light is on
questions.explanation: After the on-delay, NO timed contact 1TRA closes to power red, and NC timed contact 1TRB opens to remove power from green.
